items.title: What Is Morgan Stanley (MS) Really Gaining From Its AI IPO Role?
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) has taken a lead banking role on Anthropic’s planned IPO, described as potentially the largest on record. The mandate places Morgan Stanley at the center of Anthropic’s listing process and related capital raising for the AI developer. The bank’s involvement in Anthropic’s float adds to its broader exposure to large scale financing tied directly to the AI sector.
